description.p: Phodder subscribes to podcasts, downloads new episodes in the background and plays them from a queue ordered by group.

ul.li: Groups put daily shows ahead of the rest
Download filters and automatic chapter skipping per podcast
Pauses for calls and resumes when Bluetooth reconnects
Phodder no longer leaves a hidden window running in the background.
Phodder in the background gives memory back after refreshing large feeds.
The player keeps showing the episode when a Bluetooth device disconnects.
The app icon is taller, to match other icons of its shape.

description.p: Quit now also stops Phodder in the background.

ul.li: A queue ordered by group, so daily shows come first
Background refreshes and downloads, with filters and expiry per podcast
Chapters, automatic chapter skipping and transcripts
Sync with Nextcloud GPodder Sync and gpodder.net
Pauses for calls and resumes when Bluetooth reconnects
